title: Speculation and deduction
grammar: Must, Might, Could, Cannot (deduction), Modal perfects
function: Speculate about the present and the past

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn to speculate and make deductions about present and past situations using modal verbs and modal perfects.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. He must be at work. She might have forgotten. They cannot have left already. Notice: must/might/cannot for deduction, must have/might have/cannot have for past deduction.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: The lights are off. They ___ gone out.
phases.explanation: When we are almost certain about the past, we use must have + past participle.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Your neighbour is playing loud music at 2 am. Write 3 speculations about why.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: She ___ the message. She was not at home.
phases.explanation: Cannot have + past participle expresses impossibility in the past.
